shots.h: Your PC shuts down when you say so
shots.p: Shut down, restart, sleep or lock at the exact time, with a countdown that is always clear.

shots.h: Pick the time by turning the clock
shots.p: Drag the hand, use the +15 min to +2 h shortcuts or jump to another day. You always see how long is left.

shots.h: Wait until your work is done
shots.p: Only act once CPU, network or battery drop, or when an app goes idle.
Mix network, CPU, battery and idle apps. The action waits until all of them are met.
A floating widget with the time left and the active conditions, in the corner you choose.
Follows your Windows theme and adapts to any window size.

tagline: Shut down, restart or sleep your PC at just the right moment.
